import sys

def make_spiral(n: int):
    # Initialize all cells as spaces
    g = [[' ' for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]

    # Directions: up, right, down, left
    dirs = [(-1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1)]
    d = 0

    # Start from bottom-left
    r, c = n - 1, 0
    g[r][c] = '#'

    while True:
        dr, dc = dirs[d]
        nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc

        # Can move if inside and unvisited
        if 0 <= nr < n and 0 <= nc < n and g[nr][nc] == ' ':
            # Prevent touching the existing spiral too early:
            # after moving to (nr, nc), the cell one more step ahead
            # in the same direction must not already be '#'
            nnr, nnc = nr + dr, nc + dc
            if 0 <= nnr < n and 0 <= nnc < n and g[nnr][nnc] == '#':
                # turn right instead
                nd = (d + 1) % 4
                tdr, tdc = dirs[nd]
                tr, tc = r + tdr, c + tdc
                if 0 <= tr < n and 0 <= tc < n and g[tr][tc] == ' ':
                    d = nd
                    r, c = tr, tc
                    g[r][c] = '#'
                else:
                    break
            else:
                r, c = nr, nc
                g[r][c] = '#'
        else:
            # turn right
            nd = (d + 1) % 4
            tdr, tdc = dirs[nd]
            tr, tc = r + tdr, c + tdc
            if 0 <= tr < n and 0 <= tc < n and g[tr][tc] == ' ':
                d = nd
                r, c = tr, tc
                g[r][c] = '#'
            else:
                break

    return [''.join(row) for row in g]

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data)
    print('\n'.join(make_spiral(n)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
